headline: Prashant Verma re-appointed as CISO for three years
why: Routine re-appointment of the Chief Information Security Officer; does not alter investment thesis.

people.name: Prashant Verma
people.background: Around 21 years of full-time experience on Security Domain. Previously headed Cyber Risk Unit at Bajaj Finance Ltd, worked as security auditor and consultant for domestic and international banks and insurance companies. CISSP and co-author of security books.
